blurb: Guests board vessels departing from Penetanguishene or Honey Harbour to experience Georgian Bay's scenery. Cruises include sightseeing, food and specialty cruises aboard the Georgian Legacy, and a shuttle service to Beausoleil Island on the DayTripper. Private charters and event packages are available on several vessels.
